en.name: JSON to Code Generator
en.description: Convert JSON data to code in 10 languages: TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, Swift, MySQL, and Protobuf. This JSON to code tool helps you generate type definitions, data classes, structs, and schema statements from JSON examples — all in your browser.

hero.trustHtml: 100% client-side generation. Your JSON data never leaves your browser.

meta.title: JSON to Code — TypeScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, C#, Swift — Free Online
meta.description: Convert JSON to TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, Swift, MySQL, or Protobuf online. Generate type definitions, classes, structs, and schemas from JSON data automatically. Free, 100% client-side.

features.title: 10 Languages
features.description: Generate code in TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, Swift, MySQL (CREATE TABLE), and Protobuf (.proto messages). Choose the target that matches your stack.

features.title: Copy & Download
features.description: Copy the generated code to your clipboard or download it as a source file (.ts, .py, .go, .rs, .java, .kt, .cs, .swift, .sql, or .proto). Use it directly in your project.

features.title: Customizable
features.description: Configure the root type name and naming conventions. Adjust how the generator treats keys and types to match your project's style.

features.title: Nested Support
features.description: Creates separate type definitions, classes, or structs for nested objects. This keeps the generated code organized and idiomatic in each language.

features.title: File Upload
features.description: Upload .json files directly from your device for conversion. The file is read locally in your browser and is not uploaded to any server.

features.title: Private
features.description: All code generation happens in your browser. Your JSON data is not uploaded to a server, which is useful when working with private API responses or configuration data.

guide.title: Paste your JSON
guide.description: Paste a JSON object or array into the input field, or upload a .json file. Use representative examples of your data for best type inference.

guide.title: Select language
guide.description: Choose your target language from 10 options: TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, Swift, MySQL, or Protobuf. The generator adapts the output to each language's conventions.

guide.title: Configure type name
guide.description: Enter a custom type name (default: RootObject). For nested objects, the generator will derive related names automatically.

guide.title: Generate and use
guide.description: Click Generate to produce code. Copy the output to your clipboard or download it as a source file, then import or integrate it into your project.

example.useCase: Quickly generate Go structs, C# classes, or Python dataclasses from JSON.

faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All code generation happens locally in your browser. Your JSON data never leaves your device and is not stored or transmitted anywhere.

faq.question: Which languages are supported?
faq.answer: 10 languages: TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, Swift, MySQL (CREATE TABLE statements), and Protobuf (.proto message definitions).

faq.question: Does it handle nested objects?
faq.answer: Yes. The generator creates separate type definitions, classes, or structs for nested objects in all supported languages, keeping the code organized and idiomatic.

faq.question: Can I customize the type name?
faq.answer: Yes. Enter a custom type name in the 'Type Name' field. The default is 'RootObject', but you can use any valid identifier for your language.

faq.question: What is MySQL output used for?
faq.answer: The MySQL option generates a CREATE TABLE statement based on your JSON structure. This is useful for quickly prototyping database schemas from API responses or data samples.

faq.question: What is Protobuf output?
faq.answer: Protobuf (Protocol Buffers) generates .proto message definitions. These can be used with gRPC, Google services, and other systems that rely on Protocol Buffers for interface contracts.

faq.question: Does it infer types correctly?
faq.answer: The generator infers types based on the JSON values it sees (strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, objects). For best results, use representative JSON examples that reflect the full range of your data.

faq.question: Can I download the generated code?
faq.answer: Yes. You can copy the generated code to your clipboard or download it as a source file with the appropriate extension for the selected language.

faq.question: Is this a free JSON to code generator?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a free online JSON to code generator. You can paste JSON or upload files, select a language, and generate code without creating an account or uploading data to a server.

faq.question: 我的 JSON 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有代码生成都在浏览器本地完成，你的 JSON 数据不会离开设备，也不会被存储或传输到任何地方。

faq.question: 支持哪些语言？
faq.answer: 支持 10 种语言：TypeScript、Python、Go、Rust、Java、Kotlin、C#、Swift、MySQL（CREATE TABLE 语句）和 Protobuf（.proto 消息定义）。

faq.question: 能处理嵌套对象吗？
faq.answer: 能。生成器会为所有支持的语言创建嵌套对象的单独类型定义、类或结构体，使生成的代码结构清晰、符合各语言的习惯写法。

faq.question: 可以自定义类型名称吗？
faq.answer: 可以。在“类型名称”字段中输入自定义名称。默认是 'RootObject'，但你可以使用任何在目标语言中合法的标识符。

faq.question: MySQL 输出有什么用？
faq.answer: MySQL 选项会根据你的 JSON 结构生成 CREATE TABLE 语句。这对于从 API 响应或数据样本快速原型化数据库 schema 非常有用。

faq.question: Protobuf 输出是什么？
faq.answer: Protobuf（Protocol Buffers）会生成 .proto 消息定义。这些可以用于 gRPC、Google 服务以及其他依赖 Protocol Buffers 作为接口契约的系统。

faq.question: 类型推断准确吗？
faq.answer: 生成器会根据 JSON 中看到的值推断类型（字符串、数字、布尔值、数组、对象）。为获得最佳结果，请使用能反映数据完整范围的 JSON 示例。

faq.question: 可以下载生成的代码吗？
faq.answer: 可以。你可以将生成的代码复制到剪贴板，或下载为对应语言的源文件，然后直接用于项目中。

faq.question: 这是一个免费的 JSON 转代码生成器吗？
faq.answer: 是的。这是一个免费的在线 JSON 转代码生成器。你可以粘贴 JSON 或上传文件，选择语言并生成代码，无需创建账号或将数据上传到服务器。
